summary: Cadeler plc filed a Form 6-K on 12 November 2026 furnishing a press release dated 11 November 2026 announcing an exclusivity agreement with an undisclosed client for wind turbine and foundation installation at a large-scale UK offshore wind farm. No price, stake, premium or consideration is disclosed; the installation campaign is expected to commence around 2030, using A-Class and O-Class vessels for foundations and a P-Class vessel for turbines. This is an ordinary commercial capacity-reservation contract, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock applies. Watch for a firm contract award and backlog conversion.
